# intenter approval

Inspect and change one approval

Works on a single approval by its id (the ID column of `intenter approvals`):
show what it covers and what would stop it matching, or disable, enable or
revoke it. Nothing is ever deleted; a revoked approval stays in the history.

## Usage

```text
intenter approval
```

## Examples

```console
intenter approval show 3
intenter approval disable 3
intenter approval revoke 3
```

## Subcommands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`intenter approval disable`](intenter_approval_disable.md) | Temporarily stop an approval from matching |
| [`intenter approval enable`](intenter_approval_enable.md) | Let a disabled approval match again |
| [`intenter approval revoke`](intenter_approval_revoke.md) | Permanently stop a permission from matching |
| [`intenter approval show`](intenter_approval_show.md) | Show everything one approval covers |
